title: Models and Analysis of Vocal Emissions for Biomedical Applications
summary: This volume collects the contributions presented at the 14th International Workshop on Models and Analysis of Vocal Emissions for Biomedical Applications (MAVEBA 2025), held in Florence on December 16 –17, 2025. Since 1999, MAVEBA has been a biennial multidisciplinary forum on the study of the human voice and its biomedical applications. The workshop focuses on quantitative assessment of voice disorders, singing voice parameters, newborn cry analysis, and modelling of vocal fold and vocal tract dynamics, also highlighting advances such as Artificial Intelligence. It brings together researchers and clinicians across bioengineering, otolaryngology, phoniatrics, neurology, speech therapy, linguistics, and related fields, with emphasis on translational research and real-world impact.
